name: limit_zero_is_not_a_copy
why: Asking to remove copy «0». It is the mistake of whoever counts from zero the way the code counts, and it is NOT HARMLESS -- but not for the reason it seems. Measured: for SOLIDWORKS writing `SkippedItemArray = {0}` means «no copy removed», that is PUT THEM ALL BACK. So a zero passed on there as it is would not remove the original: it would silently cancel all the copies removed before, answering that it went well. It is the defect that gives no error, and it is avoided by refusing the number beforehand.

expect.tolerance_why: the centre is read from CylinderParams
